Ana (CISO): Heads-up team — rolling out two immediate security controls this week: mandatory MFA for all interactive accounts (SSO + 2FA) and automatic expiry for long-lived service tokens older than 90 days. Action items below.
Priya R: Thanks Ana — what's the rollout timeline?
Ana (CISO): Timeline: MFA enforcement starts 2026-04-05 (users who haven't enrolled will receive staged reminders). Service token expiry job starts 2026-04-12; tokens >90d will be marked for rotation, >120d will be revoked.
Jordan L: For service tokens, is there a safe migration path for infra jobs?
Ana (CISO): Yes — use Managed Service Identities (MSI) or short-lived IAM creds where possible. We've published a migration guide and helper scripts. Link: https://internal.redwood/example/mfa-service-token-migration
Luca I: Can you paste the helper script snippet?
Priya R: @Luca here's the quick check to list tokens older than 90d: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://internal-api.redwood/v1/service-tokens | jq '.tokens[] | select(.age_days > 90)'
```
Emma S: Who owns the exceptions process if a partner integration cannot rotate in time?
Ana (CISO): Exceptions: submit a ticket to security-exceptions with justification, compensating controls, and an end date. Exceptions are temporary (max 30 days) and require approval from the CISO team.
sec-bot: automated notice: On 2026-04-12 03:00 UTC the token-expiry-runner will begin scanning. A dry-run will occur 24h prior and we will post a report in #eng-security.
Jordan L: Will the dry-run show which tokens will be revoked so we can pre-rotate?
Ana (CISO): Yes — dry-run report will include token id, owner, age_days, and suggested remediation owner. We'll also bulk notify token owners via email.
Luca I: If a job runs on an older token, will we get 401s or a custom header?
Ana (CISO): Standard behavior: token marked for rotation -> will still work during the 30-day remediation window. After hard-revoke you will see 401. We plan to add `X-Token-Expiry-Warning` header during the remediation window for a few weeks.
Emma S: Do we need infra changes to support MSI? Any docs for Terraform providers?
Ana (CISO): Yes, we added Terraform examples in the guide and a `provider` snippet for both AWS and GCP. See the repo: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-token-migration. Reach out to platform-eng for hands-on help.
Priya R: Noted. I'll schedule a team rotation sprint this week.
Jordan L: Thanks — will start scanning our services and tagging owners.
sec-bot: reminder queued: 2026-04-04 10:00 UTC — MFA enrollment nudges to users who haven't enrolled.
Ana (CISO): Thanks all. Please escalate blockers in this thread or DM me. :lock: :shield:
Emma S: Got it, will sync with platform.
